Among 2020-2024 papers containing "imitated" , 23.8% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a far lower rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "imitated" are in the bottom 9th percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better).
Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
